description:
Send an invoice to the recipient(s).

This function sends a previously created invoice to its intended recipients.

Checked by fizzl-paypal-guard before it runs: within the owner's limits; above them the owner approves or denies.

additional_recipients.description: Additional email addresses to which to send the invoice.

invoice_id.description: The ID of the invoice to send.

send_to_recipient.description: Indicates whether to send the invoice to the recipient.

name: send_invoice
